text: 0.13.0 counts consecutive acknowledgements and stops the second, and the reason given was that the first is a prediction the second falsifies. The hint and the shipped gates.md both asked only for why another round is justified — never for a prediction — so the derivation read a claim the harness had not required, and an operator who acknowledged a flat round while enumerating a new class had promised nothing. The instruction now names the ground on which the next firing falls, which is what the count tests. No guard would have caught this: both restatements agreed with each other and neither agreed with the code
source: aix-harness-fix rebuttal 1 / verified in plan.rs and gates.md
